extract_batch with unsupported bytes MIME type

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [ExtractInput(bytes=[100, 97, 116, 97], kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="application/x-unknown")]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
